statement.ja: potentially conflicting gestureを実装するAR appをtestする。

conditions: Apply when two gestures can be difficult to distinguish, such as pinch and rotation.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Augmented reality experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるAugmented realityの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

source.evidence_paraphrase: Test an AR app whenever it implements potentially conflicting gestures.

portable_interpretation: Preserve the user-centered intent after replacing Apple-specific platforms, components, and input conventions.
